verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's own registered agent service documents electronic receipt of critical legal documents, with phone notification when service of process arrives. The public API spec also exposes registered-agent-deliveries endpoints, which supports electronic delivery into the account. Neither the physical street-office acceptance nor same-day scanning is evidenced. Missing for 10: documentation of a physical street office (not a PO box) accepting service, a same-day scan/upload commitment or SLA, and independent or hands-on corroboration of delivery timing.
